context:
Goal: a lane never re-pushes a branch already merged into main.
Problem (rule): the cloud's own Stop-hook script counts main's commits as unpushed when its origin/HEAD is stale. One lane followed it and recreated a merged branch with 502 commits. Patching that shared platform script goes against a recorded call and your ruling on shared tools, so the choice is yours.
Based on (decision): lanes-start-in-tool-worktrees records "no patch to the platform's script" (2026-11-01 23:39 CST).
Based on (measured): the 502-commit recreation of a merged branch.
Departs from: main has no such check — adds a lane-brief line: before ending, fetch, and `git rev-list --count origin/main..HEAD` must not count main's own commits.
Meanwhile: lane stop-push-skips-merged (session_013NEJKz3J95T7tJBtSYUXZ9) waits idle, and the coordinator's lane briefs already carry option a.

options.gain: No patched platform file; lanes get a clear stop before a stray push.
options.how: Each lane brief says: before ending, fetch, then `git rev-list --count origin/main..HEAD` must not count main's own commits. Can combine with c.
options.label: Add a check to lane briefs (Recommended)
options.lose: A written instruction, not a mechanism; a lane can still miss it.

options.gain: The nudge stops naming merged branches, by a mechanism.
options.how: Goes against your ruling: a repo changes to fit a shared tool, never the tool to fit a repo. session_start.sh adds a one-line skip after the platform writes its script; a test goes red when the platform's script text changes.
options.label: Patch the platform script from our session-start hook
options.lose: A shared platform file is patched to fit this repo; the test is its only guard when the platform changes it.

options.gain: No repo change; the platform may fix it for every session.
options.how: The issue goes to Anthropic. Can combine with a.
options.label: Report it to the platform team
options.lose: Alone, the harm stays until the platform fixes it.

reply: Your pick b stands. Reopened 13:29 CST Nov 9 so lane stop-push-skips-merged can read your answer from the page (decision relayed-grant-read-from-page). It closes when that lane reports done. Home: step stop-push-skips-merged.
short: Patch the cloud Stop hook's unpushed-commits nudge
title: How should lanes stop re-pushing branches already merged into main, when the cloud's Stop-hook script wrongly calls them unpushed?
